meta.title: Bedrock core journeys
meta.description: Ordered multi-stage walks through the chamber atlas for ground-shaking life. Chambers are stations; journeys are paths. Shared spine: blow → near → spiral → fork → long_middle → remain. People loop spiral↔fork↔long_middle; the path is to keep walking, not complete a checklist.

families.body: Blow to the body — loss, wound, abandonment
families.will: Blow to the will — bondage, loops, grip, mind war
families.conscience: Blow to the conscience — fall, return, regret
families.world: Blow to the world — persecution, warfare, forced wait

journeys.title: Death of a loved one
journeys.summary: Mourning is not unbelief. Hope does not erase tears; it frames them. Empty hands; remain today.

stages.label: The blow
stages.note: Name the death. Mourning is not unbelief.

stages.label: Who holds me
stages.note: Presence before advice.

stages.label: What still stands
stages.note: Faithful when the chair is empty.

stages.label: Pour out
stages.note: Do not perform fine.

stages.label: Pain and glory
stages.note: Present pain real; future glory more real. Hold both.

stages.label: The long middle
stages.note: Time moves; they do not.

stages.label: Guard the mind
stages.note: Peace given, not earned by gripping the timeline.

journeys.title: Spouse left
journeys.summary: You were wounded. Their leaving does not cancel whose you are. Critical to healing: your emotional state is your own — not dependent on them. Operational standard: Kill the Flesh. Walk in the Spirit. — return to your side of the street; refuse the remote. Adult position. Hold it.

stages.label: The wound
stages.note: Name harm. Do not make hatred your shelter.

stages.label: Whose you are
stages.note: Their leaving does not cancel you are His. Your emotional state is your own — not dependent on them.

stages.label: The replay
stages.note: Obsession is not revelation. Do not hand the loop the remote to your insides.

stages.label: Abandonment fear
stages.note: Name the fear; then trust. Adult position: refuse fear the throne of your state.

stages.label: Courtroom of the mind
stages.note: Flesh wants repayment; entrust the scales.

stages.label: Do not repay
stages.note: Bless; do not multiply darkness.

stages.label: Covenant honesty
stages.note: Do not invent a new story. Faithful to what God still calls true — not self-erasure in harm.

stages.label: Forgiveness over time
stages.note: Not saying it did not hurt. Release the ledger while grief remains.

stages.label: Long middle
stages.note: One duty you own today.

stages.label: Release the outcome
stages.note: You cannot grip the outcome.

stages.label: The Rubric
stages.note: Operational standard under fire: refuse the flesh; walk in the Spirit; your side of the street.

stages.label: Keep remaining
stages.note: Steadfast under trial.

journeys.title: Betrayal
journeys.summary: You were harmed. God sees. Do not repay evil; forgive over time; keep wise boundaries.

stages.label: The wound
stages.note: Name harm without false total blame.

stages.label: He is for you
stages.note: Cast the care; do not decorate it.

stages.label: Do not repay
stages.note: Evil repaid multiplies darkness.

stages.label: Leave vengeance
stages.note: Stillness is a weapon.

stages.label: Forgive as forgiven
stages.note: Frees you to obey while grief remains.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Receive the guard over heart and mind.

journeys.title: Abandonment fear
journeys.summary: Perfect love casts out fear. You cry Abba — not slave to terror. Trust when the face is gone.

stages.label: Name the fear
stages.note: Perfect love casts out fear.

stages.label: Do not fear
stages.note: Command and comfort.

stages.label: He is for you
stages.note: Stop rehearsing every face against you.

stages.label: Promises
stages.note: What does not depend on them.

stages.label: Capture the spiral
stages.note: Fear thoughts are not prophecy.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Let the peace of Christ rule this hour.

journeys.title: Addiction
journeys.summary: If it masters you, it is not free. Name the master; walk by the Spirit one hour; get real help.

stages.label: Name the master
stages.note: Lawful is not free if it masters you.

stages.label: Capture the craving
stages.note: Craving is not command.

stages.label: Renew the mind
stages.note: World pattern reasserts by default.

stages.label: Walk by the Spirit
stages.note: Put the flesh to death one hour at a time.

stages.label: Self-control
stages.note: Spirit fruit for you.

stages.label: Confess and forsake
stages.note: Freedom is not alone-willpower theater.

stages.label: Grace for this hour
stages.note: Weakness is where His power is perfected.

stages.label: Keep remaining
stages.note: One next sober step; real help when needed.

journeys.title: Obsession
journeys.summary: The stuck replaying mind is not the Holy Spirit. Capture → replace → next obedient step.

stages.label: Name the loop
stages.note: Obsession is not revelation.

stages.label: Take captive
stages.note: Capture to obey Christ.

stages.label: The Word
stages.note: Open Scripture; fight fog with light.

stages.label: Pray the spiral
stages.note: Do not feed the loop.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Next duty, not more analysis.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Mind stayed on Him.

journeys.title: Control grip
journeys.summary: Open the hand. Trust is not passivity. Self-control rules you — not them. Critical: emotional state is your own; refuse the remote. Operational standard: Kill the Flesh. Walk in the Spirit. — return to your side of the street.
plainSpeech: return to your side of the street

stages.label: Name the grip
stages.note: Emotional state is your own — not dependent on them. Outcomes, people, image, timeline: if you must hold it, it has become a god. Open the hand.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Release the outcome you cannot rule.

stages.label: Patience
stages.note: You are not the weather.

stages.label: Wait
stages.note: Do the one duty you own today.

stages.label: Self-control
stages.note: Rules you, not them.

stages.label: Walk by the Spirit
stages.note: Flesh wants the last word over another life.

stages.label: The Rubric
stages.note: Full operational standard: refuse the flesh; side of the street; success without their response.

journeys.title: Jealousy
journeys.summary: Jealousy is not love. Capture the rivalry; choose selfless love; trust God with what is not yours to grip.

stages.label: Name jealousy
stages.note: Not love.

stages.label: Capture
stages.note: Rival thoughts are not truth.

stages.label: Leave vengeance
stages.note: Do not turn rivalry into payback.

stages.label: Selfless love
stages.note: Love does not seek its own way.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Release what is not yours to grip.

journeys.title: I fell
journeys.summary: Name the fall. Confess. Grace is enough. Rise. The righteous man falls and gets up again. Hub path after any journey’s failure.

stages.label: Name the fall
stages.note: I sinned. I am not finished.

stages.label: Confess and be cleansed
stages.note: Concealment will not prosper.

stages.label: Grace sufficient
stages.note: Receive mercy; renounce the flesh habit.

stages.label: No condemnation
stages.note: Self-hate is not holiness.

stages.label: Walk by the Spirit
stages.note: Rise and walk again.

stages.label: Godly grief
stages.note: Refuse the death-tape of worldly grief.

stages.label: Hope of glory
stages.note: Your fall does not cancel the crucible.

journeys.title: Sexual sin
journeys.summary: Confess, forsake, be cleansed. Do not call darkness a new identity. Deny yourself; walk by the Spirit.

stages.label: Name it
stages.note: Not your own; do not rename darkness.

stages.label: Confess
stages.note: Forsake; receive cleansing.

stages.label: Deny yourself
stages.note: Cross daily; refuse self as god of this hour.

stages.label: Self-control
stages.note: Spirit fruit.

stages.label: Walk by the Spirit
stages.note: One hour free.

stages.label: Faithfulness
stages.note: When marriage is in view — faithfulness, not fantasy.

stages.label: Rise
stages.note: Identity is not the sin.

journeys.title: Stuck regret
journeys.summary: Godly grief leads to life; worldly grief leads to death. Own what is yours; refuse self-hate as god; rise.

stages.label: Name the regret
stages.note: Godly grief vs death-tape.

stages.label: If sin — confess
stages.note: Own what is yours.

stages.label: Grace
stages.note: No condemnation theater.

stages.label: Cross
stages.note: Christ died for sins; rise.

stages.label: Stop the replay
stages.note: Regret loop is not holiness.

stages.label: Rise
stages.note: Next obedience.

journeys.title: Persecution
journeys.summary: Blessed when persecuted for righteousness. Armor on; do not repay; remain faithful; hope of glory.
plainSpeech: they're against me for my faith

stages.label: Name persecution
stages.note: For His name — not every conflict is this.

stages.label: Full armor
stages.note: Stand.

stages.label: Warfare right-sized
stages.note: Not against flesh and blood; no devil-fascination.

stages.label: Do not repay
stages.note: Bless when insulted.

stages.label: Faithful servant
stages.note: Found doing when He comes.

stages.label: Hope of glory
stages.note: Crowns for those who remain.

journeys.title: Spiritual warfare
journeys.summary: The adversary is real. Name him, resist, stand with God. Fix eyes on Christ — not devil-fascination.

stages.label: Name the war
stages.note: Not against flesh and blood.

stages.label: The adversary
stages.note: Real; do not fixate.

stages.label: Armor
stages.note: Stand equipped.

stages.label: The Word
stages.note: Sword of the Spirit; fight the lie you cannot understand.

stages.label: Prayer
stages.note: Pray; do not spiral into fascination.

stages.label: Capture thoughts
stages.note: Accusation and despair are not the Spirit.

stages.label: Stand
stages.note: Eyes on Christ.

journeys.title: Forced waiting
journeys.summary: You cannot force the timeline. Wait on the Lord; trust; one duty today; provision for this day.

stages.label: Can't force it
stages.note: Urgency is not wisdom.

stages.label: Wait on the Lord
stages.note: Do the one duty you own today.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Lean not on panic as wisdom.

stages.label: God first
stages.note: Seek first the kingdom in the next five minutes.

stages.label: Daily bread
stages.note: This day, not the whole future.

stages.label: Prayer
stages.note: Cast cares; do not decorate them.

stages.label: Remain
stages.note: Keep remaining today.

journeys.title: Battlefield of the mind
journeys.summary: The war is often inside — investigation, condemnation, sticky words, and fiery darts that are not the Spirit. Capture the thought. Refuse the accuser. Renew the mind. Stand in the armor of God. Field card: Kill the Flesh. Walk in the Spirit.

stages.label: Name the war
stages.note: The blow is a thought. Capture it. Weapons demolish strongholds.

stages.label: Field card
stages.note: Boiled steel first. Investigation and condemnation named. Full holds when needed.

stages.label: The loop
stages.note: Replay and investigation are not the Holy Spirit. Capture → replace.

stages.label: Fiery darts
stages.note: Fiery darts and schemes. Do not give him the microphone of your mind.

stages.label: Condemnation
stages.note: Self-tape and unforgiveness of self. Godly grief → life; worldly grief → death. No self-hate holiness.

stages.label: Sticky words
stages.note: What they said can lodge. God near the crushed; do not make hatred your shelter.

stages.label: Renew the mind
stages.note: One thought at a time. Word over the spiral.

stages.label: Fear of punishment
stages.note: Perfect love casts out fear. Sound mind.

stages.label: Guard
stages.note: Peace given — not earned by solving every case.

stages.label: Stand
stages.note: Shield of faith extinguishes darts. Stand.
